data.name: Ghost Crystal
data.description:
Ghost Crystal is a spellcaster Evening Star Alchemia jewelia that deals magical damage, debuted in the Renkiden ~ Ghost Crystal event. 

Lore:
Ghost Crystal is a jewelia who lived on an uninhabited island where a certain treasure was enshrined. It seems that her mission was to protect the treasure, and that she was in charge of the task soon after she was born.

Although she lived alone on the island, it seems that rarely there were some people who visited the island. However, the people who witnessed Ghost Crystal misled her as a ghost and escaped. The reason is because of she has a condition where parts of her body is transparent.

The three others, Tinctura, Sea Blue Chalcedony and Black Coral who accompanied the Star Savior also believed that she was a ghost when they first saw Ghost Crystal, and everyone except Star Savior was scared.

It seems that when her starlight is insufficient, her body is transparent enough to disappear. When the savior came to the island, Ghost Crystal was so exhausted of power that even Tinctura said, "I feel her starlight is barely recognizable as a jewel princess."

However, it seems that her whole body is not transparent, notably her core stone, and her thick chest and hips are visible enough to be not transparent.

Personality:
Initially, Ghost Crystal is incredibly shy, which does not help with interacting with people and overcoming her extreme loneliness. She has stayed so long alone in the island she was born that she made her two wisps as her imaginary friends.

After interacting with Star Savior and his team, Ghost Crystal shows more of her very inquisitive personality, often poking around at whatever thing she finds interesting and is easily fascinated and eager to learn more.

As she has survived very long in an uninhabited island, she is very resourceful and has learnt how to live by herself, it is said that she would identify and collect delicious fruit and nuts and put them in a line.

She is also quite mischievous, taking advantage of her transparent ability and did a jump-scare prank that impressed Star Savior.
